skill.desc.peerless_spear:
For 4 seconds, the spear lengthens and basic attacks pierce up to 3 enemies ahead.
Deals {atk.png} 130% damage to the main target and 60% to each enemy behind.
skill.desc.spell_echo:
Copies one ally's next skill
and repeats it at half its original effect.
skill.desc.prophetic_mirror:
Up to 2 allies each cast their next attack spell once more.
The copied spells strike at 80% power, based on your own ATK.
skill.desc.call_of_the_dead:
Summons 3 undead.
When recast, replaces up to 2 fallen summons.
skill.desc.legion_of_the_dead:
Summons 4 undead.
When recast, replaces up to 3 fallen summons.
skill.desc.bramble_prison:
Deals {atk.png} 120% damage to an enemy and traps it in a wooden cage.
The trapped enemy must break the cage with its attacks first.
skill.desc.elderwood_prison:
Deals {atk.png} 140% damage to up to 2 enemies and traps each in a wooden cage.
Trapped enemies must break their own cages with their attacks first.
skill.desc.dimensional_duel:
Slashes an enemy for {atk.png} 200% damage, then duels it alone in a rift in time for 2.5 seconds.
Gains {aspd.png} +50% for the duration.
skill.desc.temporal_assault:
Slashes an enemy for {atk.png} 240% damage, then fights it alongside 1 ally in a rift in time for 3 seconds.
Gains {aspd.png} +50% for the duration.
skill.desc.heavens_judgment:
Judges an enemy with light for {atk.png} 400% damage.
Judging the same enemy again in a row raises the damage to 550%, then 700%.
skill.desc.absolute_judgment:
Judges an enemy with light for {atk.png} 500% damage.
Judging the same enemy again in a row raises the damage to 750%, then 1,000%.
skill.desc.rupturing_descent:
Plunges down, dealing 180% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies.
A shockwave bursts from each enemy hit, dealing 60% {atk.png} damage to the other enemies hit nearby.
skill.desc.doom_resonance:
Plunges down, dealing 200% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 4 enemies.
A shockwave bursts from each enemy hit, dealing 60% {atk.png} damage to the other enemies hit nearby.
skill.desc.lance_extension:
For 3 seconds, the spear lengthens and basic attacks pierce up to 2 enemies ahead.
Deals {atk.png} 130% damage to the main target and 60% to the enemy behind.
skill.desc.celestial_arsenal:
Draws a spear from a rift and fires it, dealing {atk.png} 200% damage.
For 5 seconds, when other allies use active skills, fires up to 3 extra spears.
skill.desc.rift_arsenal:
Draws a spear from a rift and fires it, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage.
For 4 seconds, when other allies use active skills, fires up to 2 extra spears.
skill.desc.eclipse_snipe:
Snipes the enemy with the lowest {hp.png}, dealing {atk.png} 300% damage.
Each kill snipes the next enemy, striking up to 3 enemies.
skill.desc.chain_snipe:
Snipes the enemy with the lowest {hp.png}, dealing {atk.png} 240% damage.
On a kill, snipes another enemy once more.
skill.desc.celestial_return:
Revives the first ally to fall at 60% of their max {hp.png}
and makes that ally's skill ready to use at once.
skill.desc.salvation_arrow: Revives the first ally to fall at 40% of their max {hp.png}.
skill.desc.grail_swordfall:
Drops giant swords of light in front of up to 3 allies, dealing
{atk.png} 70% damage to nearby enemies.
Each sword blocks one direct attack on its ally, then shatters,
dealing {atk.png} 50% damage to nearby enemies.
skill.desc.guardian_swordfall:
Drops swords of light in front of up to 2 allies, dealing
{atk.png} 60% damage to nearby enemies.
Each sword blocks one direct attack on its ally, then shatters,
dealing {atk.png} 40% damage to nearby enemies.
skill.desc.flash_barrage:
Every 7 basic attacks, teleports between enemies,
slashing up to 3 different enemies in turn before returning.
skill.desc.flash_slash:
Every 7 basic attacks, teleports to the farthest enemy,
deals {atk.png} 150% damage, and returns.
skill.desc.soul_severance:
Unleashes the power of twin scythes in every direction,
dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to up to 4 nearby enemies each.
skill.desc.reapers_dance:
Spreads twin scythes and slashes in every direction around itself,
dealing {atk.png} 160% damage to up to 3 nearby enemies each.
skill.desc.titans_gaze:
Fires a Shrink Ray,
dealing {atk.png} 140% damage to up to 2 enemies in front.
Enemies hit shrink for 3 seconds, dealing 35% less direct damage.
skill.desc.shrink_ray:
Fires a Shrink Ray,
dealing {atk.png} 140% damage.
The enemy hit shrinks for 3 seconds, dealing 30% less direct damage.
skill.desc.crescent_requital:
For 5 seconds, moonlight remembers 35% of the direct damage allies take.
When it ends, the remembered damage heals up to 3 allies,
and half of it strikes the enemy with the highest health.
skill.desc.moonlit_memory:
For 4 seconds, moonlight remembers 30% of the direct damage allies take.
When it ends, the remembered damage heals
up to 2 allies with the lowest health.
skill.desc.cataclysm_flurry:
Basic attacks have a 20% chance to unleash 5 magic thrusts in a row,
dealing a total of {atk.png} 280% damage.
skill.desc.nightmare_flurry:
Basic attacks have a 20% chance to unleash 3 magic thrusts in a row,
dealing a total of {atk.png} 200% damage.
skill.desc.soul_feast:
Fires skull bolts at up to 2 enemies, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to each,
storing half the health taken in orbs.
The orbs heal allies at 70% health or lower.
skill.desc.life_siphon:
Fires a skull bolt that deals {atk.png} 160% damage,
storing half the health it takes in an orb.
The orb heals an ally at 70% health or lower.
skill.desc.arcane_unleashing:
Three beams that grow stronger deal a total of {atk.png} 660% damage over 3 seconds.
With few enemies, several beams focus on one enemy.
skill.desc.abyssal_ray:
Fires a beam that grows stronger for 3 seconds, dealing {atk.png} 480% damage in total.
If the target falls, the rest of the beam turns to another enemy.
skill.desc.spectral_return:
A wraith breaks out of his body and pierces up to 4 enemies,
dealing {atk.png} 100% damage to each,
then {atk.png} 80% to each again on its way back.
skill.desc.spectral_rush:
A wraith breaks out of his body and rushes through enemies,
dealing {atk.png} 130% damage to each of up to 3 before returning.
skill.desc.chain_spear:
Hurls a chained spear at the farthest enemy,
dealing {atk.png} 150% damage and dragging it in front of him.
skill.desc.execution_chain:
Hurls a chained spear at the farthest enemy,
dealing {atk.png} 180% damage and dragging it in front of him.
The dragged enemy bleeds for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.devouring_arrow:
Fires a giant illusion arrow that deals {atk.png} 240% damage.
In flight it devours up to 3 enemy basic-attack projectiles and grows stronger.
skill.desc.hollow_arrow:
Fires a large illusion arrow that deals {atk.png} 170% damage.
In flight it swallows up to 2 enemy basic-attack projectiles and grows stronger.
skill.desc.twilight_barrage:
Unleashes a downpour of arrows that pushes enemies back;
each arrow deals {atk.png} 60% damage.
skill.desc.arrow_rain:
Drops a rain of black arrows one after another, pushing enemies back;
each arrow deals {atk.png} 70% damage.
skill.desc.ruin_tremor:
On a kill, stomps the ground, dealing {atk.png} 70% damage
to up to 3 nearby enemies and gaining a shield for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.arcane_collapse: Hurls a green orb at the farthest enemy. The orb pulls in up to 2 nearby enemies, then explodes, dealing {atk.png} 90% damage to each.
skill.desc.shadow_harvest:
Killing an enemy absorbs its shadow,
granting a shield equal to 15% of your max {hp.png} for 2 seconds.
skill.desc.spellblade_vortex:
Throws a spellblade at the farthest enemy.
The spinning blade damages the target and the enemy closest to it, pulling the second enemy toward the target.
skill.desc.glacial_shatter: Ice pillars deal {atk.png} 80% damage to each of up to 3 enemies in front and freeze them for 1.5 seconds. Shattering pillars deal an additional {atk.png} 70% damage to each.
skill.desc.frost_spike: Erupts ice spikes beneath up to 2 enemies in front, dealing {atk.png} 110% damage to each and freezing them for 1 second.
skill.desc.judgments_radiance: Raises a hammer to release a burst of light, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to each of up to 2 nearby enemies and preventing skill use for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.condemning_strike: Slams an enemy with a radiant hammer, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage and preventing skill use for 2 seconds.
skill.desc.wings_of_victory: Each kill or 6 basic attack hits against bosses fills 1 wing segment. At 4 segments, grants all allies {aspd.png} +25% and {spd.png} +30% for 4 seconds.
skill.desc.victory_signal: Each kill or 6 basic attack hits against bosses fills 1 flag segment. At 4 segments, grants all allies {aspd.png} +15% for 4 seconds.
skill.desc.wild_stampede: Four wild horses race across the battlefield, dealing 160% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 4 enemies and knocking them back.
skill.desc.call_of_the_plains: Two wild horses charge across the battlefield, dealing 120% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies in their path and knocking them back.
skill.desc.flame_descent: Summons 1 Flame Spirit. If it is already present, launches a giant fireball together with the spirit, dealing 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies.
skill.desc.flame_call: Summons 1 Fire Spirit. If it is already present, the spirit unleashes a flame burst that deals 70% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 nearby enemies.
skill.desc.triple_tide: Unleashes waves that deal 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies and knock them back. Restores 6% of maximum {hp.png} and removes a debuff from up to 2 allies the waves pass through.
skill.desc.cleansing_wave: Unleashes a wave that deals 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 enemies and knocks them back. Removes a debuff from 1 ally the wave passes through.

imprint.desc.earthquake_1: On hit, deals 150% ATK damage to all enemies on the battlefield and stuns them.
imprint.desc.annihilation_1: Attacks have a 35% chance to deal 160% ATK as annihilation damage to each of up to 5 nearby enemies.
imprint.desc.meteor_1: Basic attacks have a 10% chance to call down a meteor, dealing 180% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 nearby enemies. Higher maximum {hp.png} increases the meteor size and blast radius.
imprint.desc.shadow_clone_1: Summon a clone to fight alongside this unit. The clone respawns 2s after it is defeated.
imprint.desc.soul_split_1: Basic attack hits pull the enemy's soul out of its body for 3s. Damage dealt to the soul is also dealt to the body.
imprint.desc.revival_1: Revive once at 40% HP with +20% ATK for 4s
imprint.desc.majesty_1: Presence: all enemies -12% ATK, -15% Max HP
imprint.desc.ruin_1: Presence: all enemies take 6% ATK as DoT/sec

imprint.desc.overlord_1: Turn up to 2 slain enemies into followers
imprint.desc.undying_soul_1: On death: remain in battle as a Soul (40% ATK)
imprint.desc.timeless_1: 8% chance on attack: stop time for 3s

skill.desc.razorscale_rain: First activates 5 seconds after combat begins, with a 9-second cooldown. For 4 seconds, one razorscale falls every 0.5 seconds, for a total of 8. The scales draw every living ally once in a random order before reshuffling. 70% land within 2-10 pixels of the target, while 30% miss by 12-24 pixels. Landing X follows the selected unit's real combat position; Y remains within the placement area's vertical band and avoids the Stage 6 rift. Each falling scale deals 50% ATK damage only to the first ally it touches. After the final scale lands, all scales remain embedded for 2 seconds, then return to the Elder. Each returning scale also deals 50% ATK damage only to the first ally it touches.
enemy.skill.razorscale_rain.short: First cast: 5s. Cooldown: 9s. Drops 8 scales while drawing every living ally once in random order before reshuffling (70% within 2-10 pixels, 30% miss by 12-24 pixels). Landing X follows the target's real combat position; Y stays within the placement band and avoids the Stage 6 rift. Each scale deals 50% ATK to the first ally hit during its fall and return.
skill.desc.reverse_spine_carapace: Every 7 seconds, raises its spines for 3 seconds. It still takes full damage from ranged projectiles, but each projectile ricochets back to the ally that fired it and deals 50% of its original damage.
enemy.skill.reverse_spine_carapace.short: Every 7 seconds for 3 seconds, ranged projectiles ricochet back to their shooters for 50% of their original damage. The Tyrant still takes full damage.

skill.desc.void_feast: The first time HP falls to 50% or below, devours the lowest-PWR non-boss enemy within 55 range. If none is in range, moves toward the nearest eligible enemy. Restores 4%/6%/8%/10%/12% of max HP based on the victim's PWR. Cannot devour bosses, final bosses, or another Cave Devourer. Activates once per battle.
enemy.skill.void_feast.short: At 50% HP, devours the lowest-PWR enemy and restores 4–12% max HP. (Once per battle)
skill.desc.venom_maw_skills: Toxic Vomit: First casts after 3s, then every 6s. Deals 80% ATK to the ally closest to the base and creates a 4s poison pool at the position locked when fired. Every second, the pool deals 20% ATK poison damage to up to 3 allies within 42 range; overlapping pools cannot damage the same ally more than once on the same tick. Devouring Throw: First casts after 7s, then every 11s. Targets the nearest ally within basic-attack range, preferring the highest-PWR unit when multiple candidates are at a similar distance. If no ally is in range, Venom Maw moves toward the nearest one. Swallows the target for 2s, then spits it toward the largest ally cluster. Venom Maw takes 35% less damage while devouring the target. Deals 80% ATK to the victim and 50% ATK to up to 2 allies within 55 range, stunning the victim for 1s. Can be used twice per battle. If Venom Maw dies while holding a victim, the victim returns to its original position without taking damage.
enemy.skill.venom_maw_skills.short: Toxic Vomit (first 3s/CD 6s): Deals 80% ATK and creates a 4s pool (42 range, 20% ATK per second to up to 3, no overlapping damage). Devouring Throw (first 7s/CD 11s/2 uses): Targets the nearest ally in basic-attack range, prioritizing the highest PWR at similar distances. Swallows for 2s and takes 35% less damage while devouring. Then deals 80% ATK to the victim and 50% ATK to up to 2 allies within 55 range, and stuns the victim for 1s.
skill.desc.cave_basilisk_skills: Cavern Sweep: Deals 100% ATK to the nearest ally. On hit, has a 20% chance to weakly knock back the target and up to 2 nearby allies; this knockback has a 3s internal cooldown. Petrifying Gaze: First casts after 4s, then every 8s, firing a petrifying projectile at the nearest ally within 140 range. On hit, petrifies the target for 10s. The target cannot act and takes 20% more damage from Cave Basilisk. If Cave Basilisk is hit 10 times before the 10s duration ends, petrification ends immediately. The target cannot be petrified again for 3s after it ends.
enemy.skill.cave_basilisk_skills.short: Basic hits have a 20% chance to weakly knock back the target and up to 2 nearby allies (3s internal CD). First casts after 4s, then every 8s, petrifying the nearest ally within 140 range for 10s: +20% Cave Basilisk damage taken. Breaks if Cave Basilisk is hit 10 times, then grants 3s immunity.
skill.desc.lizard_warlord_roar: Every 8s, roars loudly. After the roar, all marsh puddles turn dark for 4s. Allies inside corrupted marsh can still use basic attacks, but cannot start skills. Skills already in progress are not canceled, and leaving the marsh immediately restores skill use.
enemy.skill.lizard_warlord_roar.short: Every 8s, roars. After the roar, all marsh puddles turn dark for 4s. Allies inside can basic attack, but cannot start skills. Already-running skills continue, and leaving the marsh restores skill use immediately.
skill.desc.dragonkin_boiling_marsh: Every 7s, selects 2 marsh puddles and turns them into boiling marsh for 4s. Allies inside a boiling marsh gain 1 stack of Dragonblood Burn. Dragonblood Burn lasts 4s and deals 20% of Dragonkin Shaman ATK every second. It stacks up to 3 times, and any new application refreshes all stack durations to 4s. The burn remains after leaving the marsh. If no ally is inside a puddle when it starts boiling, that puddle fires Flame Mud once at the nearest ally, dealing 80% ATK damage and applying 1 Dragonblood Burn stack.
enemy.skill.dragonkin_boiling_marsh.shor: Every 7s, turns 2 marsh puddles into boiling marsh for 4s. Allies entering gain 1 Dragonblood Burn stack. Dragonblood Burn lasts 4s, deals 20% ATK per second, stacks up to 3, and refreshes all stacks to 4s on new application. Empty puddles fire Flame Mud at the nearest ally for 80% ATK and 1 stack.

skill.desc.wasteland_piper_melody: First activates 5 seconds after battle starts. Cooldown: 12 seconds. The Piper plays the flute for 1 second, then charms the current highest-PWR ally for 3 seconds.
enemy.skill.wasteland_piper_melody.short: First cast: 5 seconds after battle starts. Cooldown: 12 seconds. Plays the flute for 1 second, then charms the current highest-PWR ally for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.demon_drive: Every 5 seconds, slams the greatsword down and pushes up to 2 nearest allied demons within 35 range in each demon's direction of travel.
enemy.skill.demon_drive.short: Every 5 seconds, slams the greatsword down and pushes up to 2 nearest allied demons within 35 range in each demon's direction of travel.
skill.desc.hell_warden_blackout: First casts 3 seconds after battle starts, then every 6 seconds. For 0.8 seconds, all player units cannot start new basic attacks or skills. Movement, actions already in progress, and launched projectiles continue normally. Ends immediately if the Hell Warden dies. At 0.25 seconds after death, it explodes for 75 damage to all player units within 50 range and inflicts a non-stacking burn that deals 8 damage per second for 4 seconds.
enemy.skill.hell_warden_blackout.short: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. Blocks new player attacks and skills for 0.8s. At 0.25s after death, explodes within 50 range for 75 damage and burns for 8 damage per second for 4s.
skill.desc.hell_witch_soul_abduction: Whenever a player unit dies while the Hell Witch is alive, she briefly performs her charm animation and summons 1 Imp at the unit's death location.
enemy.skill.hell_witch_soul_abduction.sh: Whenever a player unit dies, briefly performs a charm animation and summons 1 Imp at the death location.
skill.desc.hell_enforcer_execution: Every 6 seconds, leaps to and grabs the farthest player unit within 100 range, then strikes it 6 times over 0.9 seconds. Each hit deals 40% ATK damage, and the grabbed target cannot move. Ends immediately if the target dies; remains ready if no target is in range.
enemy.skill.hell_enforcer_execution.shor: Cooldown: 6s. Grabs the farthest player unit within 100 range and strikes 6 times over 0.9s for 40% ATK damage per hit. The target cannot move during the barrage.
skill.desc.demon_lord_dominion: Whenever an allied demon dies, grows up to 5 stacks. Each stack grants +8% size, +7% ATK, and +5% max HP, and also increases current HP by the max HP gained. At 3 stacks, basic attacks splash for 40% ATK to up to 2 player units within 35 range of the primary target. Splash damage rises to 50% at 4 stacks and 60% at 5 stacks.
enemy.skill.demon_lord_dominion.short: On allied demon death, gains up to 5 stacks of +8% size, +7% ATK, and +5% max HP. From 3 stacks, basic attacks splash to up to 2 nearby units for 40% ATK, rising to 50%/60% at 4/5 stacks.
skill.desc.dark_lord_fear_strike: First activates 4 seconds after battle starts, then every 6 seconds. The Dark Lord's sword slowly turns purple before he slams it down. On frame 15 of attack2, a purple shockwave spreads across all placeable ground, dealing 80% ATK damage to every living player unit. Units at 50% current HP or less after taking damage are feared for 1.8 seconds.
enemy.skill.dark_lord_fear_strike.short: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 6s. On attack2 frame 15, strikes all placeable ground for 80% ATK damage to every living player unit. Units at 50% current HP or less after taking damage are feared for 1.8s.
skill.desc.doom_dragon_burn: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 7s. Erupts in flame at the current attack target within basic-attack range, dealing 140% ATK to the primary target and 70% ATK to up to 3 nearby units. Damaged units burn for 25% of the Doom Dragon's ATK every second for 4 seconds. A burning unit immediately removes this burn when it uses a skill. Remains ready without a current target in range.
enemy.skill.doom_dragon_burn.short: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 7s. Deals 140% ATK to the current target in range and 70% ATK to up to 3 nearby units. Damaged units burn for 25% ATK each second for 4s. Using a skill immediately removes the burn from that unit.
skill.desc.skeleton_dragon_soul_backflow: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. When a player unit is within basic-attack range, conjures green flame on the unit with the highest ATK, dealing 120% ATK to the primary target and 50% ATK to up to 2 nearby units. For 2.5s, the primary target's basic attacks deal no damage and instead heal the Skeleton Dragon for 60% of the damage they would have dealt, capped at 25% of the Dragon's max HP per cast. Skill and imprint damage apply normally. The skill remains ready when no target is in range.
enemy.skill.skeleton_dragon_soul_backflo: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. Deals 120% ATK to the highest-ATK unit in range and 50% ATK to up to 2 nearby units. For 2.5s, the primary target's basic attacks heal the Dragon for 60% of their prevented damage, capped at 25% max HP per cast. Skills and imprints deal damage normally.
skill.desc.rift_shuriken: Every 5 seconds, throws a shuriken at 1 player unit within 140 range in the opposite lane, dealing 70% ATK damage. If there is no target in the opposite lane, the skill remains ready and is not used.
enemy.skill.rift_shuriken.short: Every 5 seconds, deals 70% ATK damage to 1 player unit within 140 range in the opposite lane. Does not activate without a valid target.
skill.desc.starlight_guard: First activates after 3 seconds, then every 6 seconds assumes a guarding stance for 2.5 seconds. While guarding, completely blocks every ranged attack arriving from the opposite lane. Attacks from the same lane deal damage normally.
enemy.skill.starlight_guard.short: First activates after 3s, then every 6s blocks every ranged attack from the opposite lane for 2.5s. Same-lane attacks deal damage normally.
skill.desc.gravity_arrow: First activates after 4 seconds, then every 7 seconds fires a powerful cosmic arrow at the farthest ranged player unit across both lanes. The hit unit's range is reduced to 55 for 3 seconds.
enemy.skill.gravity_arrow.short: First activates after 4s, then every 7s attacks the farthest ranged player unit across both lanes and reduces its range to 55 for 3s.
skill.desc.formation_breaker: Every 7 seconds, slams the player unit it is currently attacking with its shield, launching the target to the back of that lane and dealing 100% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.formation_breaker.short: Every 7s, launches its current target to the back of that lane and deals 100% ATK damage.
skill.desc.gravity_leap: Immediately after its first basic attack after combat begins, if the opposite lane has fewer player units than its current lane, it leaps across the central rift into the opposite lane. It then fights normally in that lane. Activates once per combat.
enemy.skill.gravity_leap.short: After its first basic attack, leaps across the central rift if the opposite lane has fewer player units than its current lane, then fights there normally. Once per combat.
skill.desc.spatial_exchange: First activates after 5 seconds, then every 8 seconds plants its staff into the ground, randomly selecting one player unit from each lane and swapping their positions. If either lane has no valid target, the skill remains ready.
enemy.skill.spatial_exchange.short: First activates after 5s, then every 8s randomly selects one player unit from each lane and swaps their positions.
skill.desc.crescent_flurry: First activates after 4 seconds, then every 8 seconds spins for 2 seconds. While spinning, blocks all melee basic attacks and deflects ranged basic attacks in a straight line toward a random player unit in the opposite lane for 40% of the original damage. If that lane has no target, the projectile is deflected and disappears. Skill attacks deal damage normally.
enemy.skill.crescent_flurry.short: First activates after 4s, then every 8s for 2s. Blocks melee basics and deflects ranged basics in a straight line to a random unit in the opposite lane for 40% damage. Skill attacks are unaffected.
skill.desc.crystal_barrier: Every 8 seconds, raises its shield and creates a massive 1,100 HP crystal wall in front of itself. While the wall lives, the Guard and enemies behind it cannot be attacked; the wall must be destroyed first. The wall destroys itself after 6 seconds. When destroyed, it launches crystal shards at up to 2 player units within 35 range, each dealing 60% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.crystal_barrier.short: Every 8s, creates a 1,100 HP crystal wall ahead. It protects the Guard and enemies behind it and destroys itself after 6s. On destruction, it deals 60% ATK to up to 2 units within 35 range.
skill.desc.starlight_theft: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to knock the target back. This effect has a 2.5-second internal cooldown. First activates after 5 seconds, then every 10 seconds selects one highest-star player unit, choosing randomly among ties. On projectile hit, steals one star for 4 seconds and transforms the target into its previous-star unit form and performance, then restores the original star and unit. Only units with 2 or more stars can be targeted.
enemy.skill.starlight_theft.short: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to knock the target back (2.5s internal cooldown). First activates after 5s, then every 10s randomly selects one of the highest-star units. On hit, steals one star and transforms it into its previous-star unit for 4s. Only 2-star or higher units are valid targets.
skill.desc.hammer_rain: Does not use basic attacks. First activates after 3 seconds, then every 5 seconds drops 8 small hammers in sequence at random battlefield positions over about 3 seconds. On Stage 6, four hammers are distributed above the rift and four below it, and none land in the rift. Each hammer deals 90% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.hammer_rain.short: Does not use basic attacks. After 3s, then every 5s, drops 8 hammers at random battlefield positions over about 3s. On Stage 6, four land above the rift and four below it. Each deals 90% ATK damage.
skill.desc.twin_star_barrier: One lord appears in each lane, sharing 16,000 HP. After 6s, then every 6s, the lords alternate a 3s shield, starting with the upper lord. Only the shielding lord takes 65% less damage; the other takes normal damage.
enemy.skill.twin_star_barrier.short: One lord appears in each lane, sharing 16,000 HP. After 6s, then every 6s, the lords alternate a 3s shield, starting with the upper lord. Only the shielding lord takes 65% less damage; the other takes normal damage.
skill.desc.star_scales: Every 7s, compares living allies in the upper and lower lanes. Rises into the air, then deals 120% ATK damage to up to 3 allies in the more populated lane. If counts are equal, the Judge takes 20% more damage for 3s instead. Only ranged units can attack the Judge while airborne.
enemy.skill.star_scales.short: Every 7s, deals 120% ATK damage to up to 3 allies in the lane with more living allies. Equal counts: the Judge takes 20% more damage for 3s. Only ranged units can attack it while airborne.
